before: Move Money moves it between your own accounts: at once between two at one bank, and to another bank in the sending bank’s time, or its country’s where the bank sets none: at once where the country’s banks pay instantly, and otherwise held as Money In Transit until it lands.
after: Move Money, on Accounts, moves money between your own accounts. Between two at the same bank it moves at once. To another bank it takes the sending bank’s time, or its country’s where the bank sets none, and it shows as Money In Transit until it lands; where the country’s banks pay instantly, that’s straight away. Money in transit is pending: it has left one account and isn’t in the other yet, so it isn’t available to spend.
why: New: money available against money pending; a move out is posted to Money In Transit at once (bankmoves.ts:250).
